title: 42km: the mythical race — Mont-Blanc Marathon (English page)
claims: The English 42 km page gives the date as Sunday 28 June 2026, the start as 06:45, the distance as 42 km and the elevation as 2,540 m D+/-.

The same page describes a fast rolling opening section, then the steep and technical slopes of the Aiguillette des Posettes as the main difficulty, before a panoramic finish facing the Mont-Blanc massif.
The same page describes the 42 km as a semi-autonomous trail, limited to 2,300 runners, with 6 starting waves, a 10-hour maximum time and 3 full feed stations plus 1 finish feed station.
The same page recommends that entrants have significant mountain-running experience and notes that a runner with a UTMB performance index below 350 points has very little chance of finishing.
The same page lists the mandatory equipment: a working mobile phone, at least 1 litre of water, a waterproof jacket with a hood, a 140 x 200 cm survival blanket, a cup, a whistle and cash.

The same page lists cut-offs calculated from the last wave start: Tour aid station at km 13.5 plus 2:45, Vallorcine at km 23.5 plus 5:30, La Flegere at km 34.2 plus 8:30, and the Chamonix finish at km 42 plus 10:00.
The same page warns that GPX tracks may give different distance and elevation results depending on the system and settings used.
The same page offers a PDF map, estimated passage times and a race profile, but no GPX download link.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取英文 42 km 页面全文。该页日期仍写 Sunday, June 28, 2026，与法文页的 2027-06-27 不一致；页面只有 PDF 地图/剖面，无 GPX 直链。
